query:
SELECT e.user_id AS "user_id!", e.work_type, COALESCE(SUM(e.minutes), 0)::bigint AS "minutes!"
           FROM ops.v1_time_entries e
           WHERE e.org_id = $1
             AND e.user_id = ANY($2)
             AND e.started_at >= $3
             AND e.started_at < $4
             AND e.approval_status = 'approved'
           GROUP BY e.user_id, e.work_type
           ORDER BY e.user_id, SUM(e.minutes) DESC
